messages:
emma: FYI ticket from Acuity Labs — console shows missing first-token latency and tokens/sec sometimes negative for their dedicated pool since ~03:22 UTC. Customer sees billing weirdness too. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc123 :grimacing:
ingrid: Can you paste the account id and a sample query/time window? We need to check the raw streaming rollup and kinesis/kafka offsets.
emma: account_id: acct_ABC123. They reported window 03:20–03:40 UTC. Query they ran: `sum(tokens_processed) by account where stream="streaming-rollup"` returned negative deltas and blanks.
sanjeev: Seen this before when rollup checkpoint wraps on consumer restart. 2 quick checks: 1) kafka consumer group offsets/lags, 2) streaming-rollup logs for negative delta emits. Run:```sh
kubectl logs -l app=streaming-rollup -n prod --since=40m | grep acct_ABC123
```
leo: grabbing logs now. Ping me if you need sample log lines.
leo: log snippet:```INFO 2026-03-11T03:24:10Z acct=acct_ABC123 tokens_delta=-120 seq=18446744073709551610 checkpoint=0xFFFFFFFF``` That seq number looks like wrap/unsigned underflow.
ingrid: yep that seq is suspicious — looks like a uint64 underflow after a checkpoint reset. Any recent deploy that touched kvcache or checkpointing?
sanjeev: we shipped kvcache TTL micro-optimization 03:18 (rollout: streaming-rollup v3.4.7). It touched checkpoint persistence logic. Going to rollback the change in canary and run a quick patch to prevent negative emits.
ops-bot: deploy event: streaming-rollup v3.4.7 -> v3.4.6 (rollback) by @sanjeev started at 2026-03-11T03:30:40Z :rocket:
sanjeev: mitigation: add a guard that clamps negative deltas to 0 and emit a debug counter when clamp happens. Quick patch:```diff
- delta = cur - prev
+ delta = max(0, cur - prev)
``` We'll push hotfix to canary, monitor for tokens/sec flips.
emma: I'll update the customer with workaround and ETA (rolling back now + backfill). Can we give an ETA for backfill?
sanjeev: backfill script ready, estimate 30–45m for acct_ABC123 at current throughput. Command:```sh
python scripts/backfill_tokens.py --account acct_ABC123 --from "2026-03-11T03:00:00Z" --to "2026-03-11T04:00:00Z"
```
leo: can confirm after rollback canary shows no negative emits in the last 10m. Dashboard panels aligning with 60s windows look stable. :thumbsup:
emma: sending customer update: "We've identified a kvcache/checkpoint underflow introduced in a recent roll, rolling back and backfilling metrics. ETA ~45m." :pray:
ingrid: follow-up action: add unit test for checkpoint wrap and add monitoring alert on negative token deltas. I'll file a quick jira for postmortem.
emma: thanks team. will mark the ticket as escalated -> in progress and update when backfill completes. :eyes:
